text: Bank of Montreal (BMO) is a Canadian chartered bank listed in Toronto and New York with no state shareholder. Canadian law caps concentration: under the Bank Act no person may be a 'major shareholder' - more than 20% of any class of voting shares - of a bank of BMO's size, and none is, so the bank is institutionally dispersed by statute. Record is unremarkable; relevance is ordinary banking conduct.
short: Bank of Montreal (BMO) is a Canadian chartered bank listed in Toronto and New York with no state shareholder.

source.name: Bank of Montreal Annual Information Form for the year ended 31 October 2025 (SEC 40-F Exhibit 99.1)
source.quote: beneficially owns more than 20% of any class of voting shares or more than 30% of any class of non-voting shares of the bank.
